inference: Descriptive per released volume and feature; no participant independence, hypothesis tests, pooled sensitivity or patient-risk claims.
relative_difference: abs(candidate-reference)/abs(reference); undefined if reference is exactly zero, reported as null with a reference_zero flag.
roi: Union of released annotation labels >0, supplied as label 1 by the clinical harness.
selection: First three lexicographically sorted released volume IDs of each dataset, fixed before native or clinical outcomes; no replacement.
tolerance_interpretation: Numerical change descriptor inherited from the historical scalar comparator, not an equivalence margin or clinical threshold.
